title: potentilla gracilis var. longipedunculata
intro: Potentilla gracilis var. longipedunculata, commonly known as Chinese Five-Finger Clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the mind, relieve stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and infusions. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla gracilis var. longipedunculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
